# Setup 

```{r, include=FALSE}
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library("tidyverse"))
library("gplots")
library("ggvenn")
library("gridExtra")
```


## All genotypes in the Vicia faba PeaMUST collection

```{r all, include=FALSE}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

passeport_info_peamust <- read.csv(file = "../../../00.info/00.passeport_data/2024-11_passeport_data_and_genetic_cluster_viciafaba_peamust.csv",
                          header = TRUE, 
                          stringsAsFactors = FALSE, sep =",")

genotypes_all <- passeport_info_peamust$ivip  
```

## A. fabae datasets

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

fabae_no_filters <- read.csv(
  file = "../../../01.data/2023_screen_specifics_251genotypes/02.aphis_fabae_on_faba_collection/aphis_fabae_fecundity_on_faba_collection_2024-04-02.csv",
  header = TRUE, 
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE, 
  sep =",")

fabae_filtered <- read.csv(
  file = "../../../02.analyses/01.GWAS/01_phenotipic_analysis/01.dataset_filtering/01_A.fabae/final filters/aphis_fabae_data_filtered_6.csv",
  header = TRUE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, sep =",")

n_genotypes_no_filters <- nrow(unique(fabae_no_filters$ivip))
n_genotypes_filtered <- nrow(unique(fabae_filtered$ivip))
```

::: {.important}
There are:  
- `r n_genotypes_no_filters` genotypes in the raw _A. fabae_ dataset (no filters applied).  
- `r n_genotypes_filtered` genotypes in the filtered _A. fabae_ dataset (after applying all filters).
:::

## A. pisum datasets

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

pisum_no_filters <- read.csv(file = "../../../01.data/2023_screen_specifics_251genotypes/01.acyrthosiphon_pisum_P123amp_on_faba_collection/acyrthospipon_pisum_fecundity_on_faba_collection.csv", header = TRUE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, sep =",")

pisum_filtered <- read.csv(file = "../../../02.analyses/01.GWAS/01_phenotipic_analysis/01.dataset_filtering/02_A.pisum/final filters/acyrthosiphon_pisum_filtered_6.csv", header = TRUE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, sep =",")
```

There are:  
`r nrow(unique(pisum_no_filters$ivip))` genotypes in the raw A. pisum dataset (no filters applied).  
`r nrow(unique(pisum_filtered$ivip))` genotypes in the filtered A. pisum dataset (after applying all filters).


::: {.important}
There are:  
- `r nrow(unique(pisum_no_filters$ivip))` genotypes in the raw A. pisum dataset (no filters applied).  
- `r nrow(unique(pisum_filtered$ivip))` genotypes in the filtered A. pisum dataset (after applying all filters).
::: 


# Venn diagrams

## A. fabae

Create lists of genotypes from raw A. fabae data and after filtering.  

```{r lists_fabae}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

# Create lists of genotypes from raw A. fabae data and after filtering 
genotypes_fabae_no_filters <- unique(fabae_no_filters$ivip)
genotypes_fabae_filtered <- unique(fabae_filtered$ivip)
```

Plot the Venn diagram to visualize the overlap between the three data sets.  

```{r venn}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| echo: false

# Plot the Venn diagram
venn_data_fabae <- list(
  "All genotypes" = genotypes_all,
  "In A. fabae screen (no filters)" = genotypes_fabae_no_filters,
  "In A. fabae screen (filtered)" = genotypes_fabae_filtered
)

venn_plot_fabae <- ggvenn(
  venn_data_fabae,
  fill_color = c("#E69F00", "#56B4E9", "#009E73"),
  stroke_size = 0.5,
  set_name_size = 4,
  text_size = 3,
  show_percentage = FALSE);venn_plot_fabae
```

## A. pisum 

```{r lists_pisum}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

# Create lists of genotypes for each dataset
genotypes_pisum_no_filters <- unique(pisum_no_filters$ivip)
genotypes_pisum_filtered <- unique(pisum_filtered$ivip)
```

Plot the Venn diagram to visualize the overlap between the three datasets.  

```{r venn_pisum}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| echo: false

# Plot the Venn diagram
venn_data_pisum <- list(
  "All genotypes" = genotypes_all,
  "In A. pisum screen (no filters)" = genotypes_pisum_no_filters,
  "In A. pisum screen (filtered)" = genotypes_pisum_filtered
)
venn_plot_pisum <- ggvenn(
  venn_data_pisum,
  fill_color = c("#E69F00", "#56B4E9", "#009E73"),
  stroke_size = 0.5,
  set_name_size = 4,
  text_size = 3,
  show_percentage = FALSE);venn_plot_pisum

```

# Final list of missing genotypes

## A. fabae

```{r final_lists_fabae}
# List of missing genotypes
Afabae_missing_genotypes <- 
  setdiff(
    genotypes_fabae_no_filters, 
    genotypes_fabae_filtered) # A. fabae

afabae_missing_genotypes_df <- as.data.frame(Afabae_missing_genotypes)
afabae_missing_genotypes_df
```

## A. pisum

```{r final_lists}

# List of missing genotypes
Apisum_missing_genotypes <- 
  setdiff(
    genotypes_pisum_no_filters, 
    genotypes_pisum_filtered) # A. pisum

apisum_missing_genotypes_df <- as.data.frame(Apisum_missing_genotypes)
apisum_missing_genotypes_df
```
